task.title: Allocating the monies — Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 6 - Earnings other than declared .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Remarks line 1: Type “Input M175 E — [amount to be allocated] from [first day of allocation] to [last day of allocation].” (Example of transaction: E-$700-1679-1681).
Remarks line 5: Type your name and telephone number.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send a D-20-16-03 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Allocations of Earnings (2516): Select the appropriate option:
Allocation of earnings - Only from ROE #1 - Monies allocated beyond BPC
Allocation of earnings - Monies allocated beyond BPC are from both ROE #1 + ROE #2

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI or return to the originating task.
